#export h5ad file for scanpy processing
```{r}
library(MuDataSeurat)
```

```{r}
seu = DietSeurat(
  endocardium,
  counts = TRUE, # so, raw counts save to adata.layers['counts']
  data = TRUE, # so, log1p counts save to adata.X when scale.data = False, else adata.layers['data']
  scale.data = FALSE, # set to false
  features = rownames(endocardium), # export all genes, not just top highly variable genes
  assays = "SCT",
  dimreducs = c("pca","umap"),
  graphs = c("SCT_nn", "SCT_snn"), # to RNA_nn -> distances, RNA_snn -> connectivities
  misc = TRUE
)
```


```{r}
MuDataSeurat::WriteH5AD(seu, "endocardium.h5ad", assay="SCT")
```


#starting cell selection based on donor z score
```{r}
donor_hlhs<-read.table("/media/farid-kadyrov/Seagate Portable Drive/HLHS/2024 final version/7 hlhs sc dex/2 cardiomyocyte censoring/endocardium/donor_hlhs_intersection_censored.tsv")
```

```{r}
donorsig <- donor_hlhs[donor_hlhs$avg_log2FC > 0,]
donorsig <- donorsig[order(donorsig$avg_log2FC, decreasing = TRUE),]
#donorsig <- head(donorsig, 10)
donorsig <- as.vector(donorsig$X)
```


```{r}
#selecting monocyte based on monocyte z score

DefaultAssay(endocardium) <- "SCT"
expdata <- GetAssayData(endocardium)
zDonor <- c(donorsig)
pops<-list(zDonor)
#Z-Scores
z_scores<-NULL

for (i in 1:length(pops)) {
  genes <- pops[[i]]
  zz <- which(tolower(rownames(expdata)) %in% tolower(genes))
  av <- numeric(ncol(expdata))
  
  geneExp <- as.matrix(expdata[zz, ])
  geneExp <- t(scale(t(geneExp)))
  geneExp[is.nan(geneExp)] <- 0
  z_scores <- rbind(z_scores,(av + colSums(geneExp) / length(zz)))
}
endocardium@meta.data$Donor_z<-z_scores[1,]

DotPlot(endocardium, features = "Donor_z", group.by = "condition")
```

```{r}

Donor_z_cells<- FetchData(endocardium, vars = "Donor_z")
```
